questions.q: Exercise Tiger Triumph 2026 is a bilateral tri-service humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) exercise between India and which country?
questions.exam: Common MPSC; Inspector of Taxes; DSC LDA
questions.source: PIB Ministry of Defence release dated 3 November 2026; corroborating reporting
questions.verificationStatus: Original practice item; checked against dated primary or reputable source; not an official PYQ.
questions.e: Tiger Triumph is the India–United States tri-service HADR exercise. The 2026 edition involved joint planning and coordination centred on Visakhapatnam. It improves interoperability during disaster response, not conventional combat.

questions.q: The India S&T Scoreboard launched by NITI Aayog on 3 November 2026 presents indicators across which three sectors?
o: Academia, Government R&D Labs and Industry
questions.exam: Common MPSC; Inspector of Taxes; DSC LDA
questions.source: Press Information Bureau, Government of India, release dated 3 November 2026; NITI Aayog dashboard
questions.verificationStatus: Original practice item; checked against the PIB release dated 3 November 2026 and NITI Aayog dashboard; not a PYQ.
questions.e: The India S&T Scoreboard covers three sectors: Academia, Government R&D Labs and Industry. It brings together data on higher-education and R&D institutions, deep-tech startups and incubators with outputs such as research publications and patents. It also displays indicators of research quality, impact, collaboration and open access, enabling State/UT comparison and evidence-based policy. No unverified Meghalaya ranking or state-level count is used in this question.
